blackbody_rule.statement: For micrometer-size superpositions in diamond, blackbody radiation becomes a considerable decoherence channel above ~4 K.
blackbody_rule.conservative_use: Because the target superposition is ~50 um, treat 4 K as a conservative upper bound, not a design goal.

interpretation: At 0.1 K and 1 K the target is in the low-risk band.
At 4 K the gate is borderline.
Above 4 K blackbody is dominant enough to threaten any clean Tamesis test.
